description: "Child's Health Primer For Primary Classes" by Jane Andrews is an educational guide written in the late 19th century. This work aims to teach children fundamental concepts of physiology and hygiene with a particular emphasis on the harmful effects of intoxicating substances such as alcoholic drinks, stimulants, and narcotics.
